title: ZYNRIP THE STORM (Sea Shanty × Pirate Bass × DnB) [174]
style: Sea shanty meets pirate bass and drum and bass, 174 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave English sailor + Norwegian + te reo Maori, chopped group-call shanty vocal stacks, accordion melody runs, hurdy-gurdy drone, fiddle reels, ship-bell and wood-creak percussion, rolling Amen-style DnB break, deep Reese sub bass with slides, ocean-spray foley, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, storm-deck high-seas adventure mood, sidechain ducking pads to kick, festival mainstage 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(hurdy-gurdy drone, distant ship bell, ocean foley)
(ZYN... RIP... the... storm...)
(stor... men... stor... men...)
(ng... a... ru... ng... a... ru...)

[Build]
(accordion enters, fiddle climbs, sub slides up)
ZYN — RIP! THE — STORM!
STOR — MEN! STOR — MEN!
NGĀ — RU! NGĀ — RU!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(snare roll, ship bell triple)

[Drop 1]
(rolling DnB break, accordion lead, sub locked)
STORM!
HELM!
WAVE!
RIDE — IT!
(chop stack +7) heave-heave-ja-ja / āe-āe-heave-heave
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(fiddle solo phrase, hurdy-gurdy drone, chops trade)
(where away?) (hvor?) (kei hea?)
(off the bow!) (her!) (konei!)
(haul!) (dra!) (kume!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE HELM —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to hurdy-gurdy + accordion alone, no drums)
(whispered) zynrip... the... storm...
(soft) stormen... stormen...
(soft) ngāru... ngāru...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(snare roll builds, DnB break returns)

[Drop 2]
(double-time DnB, full shanty stack peak, accordion doubled)
ZYN — RIP — THE — STORM! (heave heave heave!)
HOLD — HELM! (dra! kume! haul!)
RIDE — WAVE! (āe āe āe!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(DnB fades, accordion resolves, ship bell fades)
(zynrip... the... storm...)
(stormen... ngāru...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(ocean foley fades to silence)
